title: Current agent-led harness architecture and execution logic
record_type: Read-only source audit supporting architecture diagrams; no new model run or execution test.

excluded_from_this_diagram: The native preset with boundary_input disabled
Live microphone or real ASR deployment
scope.interpretation: Architecture components and decision-flow nodes are explanatory decompositions, not additional LangGraph nodes or a prescribed search-read-answer sequence.

recorded_native_structure.meaning: An already exported native graph corroborates the implementation structure. Conditional edges show possible routing, not proof a node was visited in a particular run.

components.title: Timestamped conversation events
components.description: Authored conversation events enter the replay timeline. Partial/final-style labels are fixture data, not a live ASR integration.

components.title: Replay scheduler and pending jobs
components.description: The virtual clock advances to conversation arrivals, pending-job due times or the observation deadline. Completed retrieval jobs become arrived environment events.
details: Allowed fixture documents are kept in the environment; the full future fixture is not sent to the agent.
Search/read acknowledgements and their later evidence arrivals are separate events.
A completed model call also advances virtual time and can make events arrive.

components.title: Outer observe router
components.description: Checks paired messages, the deadline and model budget; obtains unseen arrivals; optionally delivers recovery feedback; advances the clock when idle; routes to investigate or END.
details: Actual outer graph: START to observe; observe conditionally to investigate or END; investigate always returns to observe.
An ordinary model final response does not itself end the outer run.

components.title: Before-model event boundary
components.description: After the current tool batch is complete, checks the deadline and budget, verifies tool-message pairing, and inserts newly arrived observations before the next model inference.

components.title: Native context preparation
components.description: Deep Agents keeps its native filesystem/context middleware and automatic summarization capability. Custom event/progress middleware is inserted after the core middleware stack.
details: Context middleware is an implementation component, not a required evidence-analysis stage.
Summarization can make another model call; model accounting counts actual starts.
The saved native graph includes PatchToolCallsMiddleware.before_agent, which handles dangling tool-call records before agent entry.

components.title: Optional progress projection
components.description: For agent-led-progress only, derives bounded facts from the already prepared visible messages and appends one temporary HumanMessage to the scheduled model request.
details: Does not modify durable message history or add a decision turn.
No access to WorldStore, unread documents or hidden future events.
Compacted or absent history remains unknown; matching source IDs do not establish unchanged or sufficient evidence.
Six recent rows per category and 6000 characters overall bound the added record.

components.title: Investigator model
components.description: One native Deep Agent chooses tool calls or ordinary final prose. The configured general-purpose subagent is disabled. The model decides whether to investigate, publish, change approach or stay silent.
details: The local default provider is Ollama and the default model is Qwen2.5 14B Instruct.
Accounting reserves each actual request before dispatch and records usage, duration and outcome on completion or failure.
Ordinary final prose stays private and ends only the investigator turn.

components.title: Native tool dispatcher
components.description: Executes the model tool-call batch and returns the matching ToolMessages. When ordinary tools finish, the inner loop returns through the event boundary for another decision.
details: A tool call can be complete while a delayed search/read evidence job is still pending.
The native loop exits after a batch only if every executed client tool has return_direct=True.
A wait-only batch normally exits the investigator; a mixed wait-plus-ordinary-tool batch normally continues to the model.

components.title: Delayed retrieval tools
components.description: Search and read_document start pending jobs and immediately return their receipts. Search returns up to three diagnostic lexical-overlap excerpts; a requested full document arrives later.
details: An unavailable source ID and an empty query return retryable failures with no job started.
Search excerpts are bounded to 150 characters and indicate truncation.
Previously arrived full-source text is not downgraded by later snippets.

components.title: Optional aids and private notes
components.description: The agent may calculate, request evidence advice or save private notes. Arithmetic checks only the supplied operation; evidence advice uses arrived context and is not publication approval.
details: evidence_check can invoke the same review model with the evidence_advice role and uses the shared model budget.
New events during advice are reported to the agent.
Virtual filesystem content and notes are private work, not external evidence.

components.title: Guarded card operations
components.description: Publication, updates and withdrawal are checked against the observation cursor and the card snapshot actually delivered to the agent. Tool outcomes are returned for the agent to reconsider, not automatically retried.
details: Empty text is not published. Unknown requested citation IDs are omitted and reported.
New unread conversation or source arrivals return new_observations.
A changed card returns conflict and the current snapshot.
Exactly matching text and citations can return unchanged without replacing the existing card.
These checks protect state consistency, not factual correctness.

components.title: Active help cards
components.description: Explicit card actions create, update or withdraw visible help. Private model prose does not appear here, and the presence of a card does not imply a correct answer.

components.title: LangGraph checkpoints
components.description: checkpoints.sqlite saves graph and native-subgraph execution state. The parent owns the checkpointer and agent-led execution uses synchronous checkpoint durability.
details: Checkpoint state includes execution/message state and the observation/recovery cursors.
This database is separate from the world transaction ledger.
A checkpoint is a saved execution state, not a semantic milestone or correctness certificate.

components.title: Durable world and call ledger
components.description: world.sqlite holds replay state, pending jobs, arrived sources, active cards, tool results and model-call accounting. Local action effects and the corresponding tool receipt are committed together.
details: A cached tool call ID must match its original operation and arguments.
Model calls are reserved with pending outcome before dispatch; a previously reserved ID cannot be resent by this module.
Recorded token usage is checked before a request; the token cap is soft and unknown usage can add cost.
Completed calls advance virtual time, separately from measured wall duration.

components.title: Monitor and exported records
components.description: Runtime callbacks export the compiled graph and events; the loopback-only monitor reads saved run data. The published website uses selected historical exports.
details: Read-only observability does not launch or control the model.
A saved graph describes possible structure, not proof that each node was visited.
Local runs do not automatically upload to the research website.

architecture_edges.label: Continue after guard and completed-batch check
Committed card change
architecture_edges.condition: state checks pass; unchanged preserves existing card

architecture_edges.label: Ordinary completed tool batch
architecture_edges.condition: not all executed client tools are return_direct

architecture_edges.label: Investigator turn ends
architecture_edges.condition: all executed client tools are return_direct

architecture_edges.label: Advance to next event or deadline
architecture_edges.condition: no unread arrivals and no eligible recovery feedback

architecture_edges.label: Persist parent and native execution state
Reserve, then finish every model request
Persist replay state and job arrivals
Transactional tool receipt and local effects

nodes.title: Observe: paired messages and terminal guards
nodes.description: Confirm tool-message pairing; if the window is closed or known budget exhausted, set a stop reason. Otherwise obtain observations.

nodes.title: Any unseen arrived events?
nodes.description: Read only environment arrivals newer than event_cursor; payload also includes active cards, notes and pending jobs.

nodes.title: Eligible optional recovery?
nodes.description: Requires the configured recovery switch, an idle final model response and no explicit wait in the latest tool-call batch, followed by the durable eligibility rules.

nodes.title: Advance virtual time
nodes.description: Advance to the next conversation event, evidence-job due time or deadline, then obtain arrived observations. No new inference is needed for this advance.

nodes.title: Append observation or recovery message
nodes.description: Persist the relevant cursor and message in graph state before entering investigate. Recovery feedback uses its own acknowledgement cursor.

nodes.title: Before-model event boundary
nodes.description: Check window/budget again, require a completed tool batch, and insert arrivals received since the prior observation before inference.

nodes.title: Prepare, reserve and call model
nodes.description: Native context preparation and optional progress precede the request. Accounting reserves it durably before dispatch, then records known usage, duration and outcome; completed calls advance replay time.

nodes.title: Did the model request tools?
nodes.description: No tool calls ends the investigator turn. Pending tool calls are dispatched through the native ToolNode.

nodes.title: Execute the complete tool batch
nodes.description: Each selected tool returns its receipt or result. Search/read receipts can describe jobs that remain pending after the batch has completed.

nodes.title: All executed tools return_direct?
nodes.description: Only an all-return-direct batch exits the native loop. wait_for_event is return_direct; mixing it with an ordinary tool normally continues the loop.

nodes.title: Investigator turn ends
nodes.description: Return control to observe. This is not itself a run-terminal condition; a new event may trigger another investigator turn.

nodes.title: Finish or suspend the run
nodes.description: Normal terminal reasons are window_closed and budget_exhausted. Exceptions are recorded as errors; deliberate graph interruption retains next nodes and is exported as paused.

edges.label: Uncaught request/runtime failure
edges.condition: including a reservation guard exception; not a successful answer

scope_notes: START is an external entry marker, not an additional decision node.
D12 covers normal termination and error/pause reporting, which have distinct outcomes.
Native tool-routing also supports generic middleware/structured-output paths; this diagram explains the active agent-led use rather than every generic factory branch.
A graph checkpoint interrupt or uncaught exception can leave the ordinary flow early.

optional_mechanism_flags.calculation_and_evidence_advice: Available optional tools in every agent-led configuration; neither is a publication prerequisite.
optional_mechanism_flags.progress_status: Experimental configuration, not the adopted research reference.

outer_preconditions: Last message is AIMessage with no tool_calls
The latest tool-call batch contains no wait_for_event
world_preconditions: Window and shared model budget remain available
Latest eligible failure is read_document/source_not_available or search/empty_search_query
Failure explicitly reports job_started=false and retryable=true
No later successful wait, pending retrieval start, displayed/unchanged publication or successful withdrawal
recovery_eligibility.delivery_rule: At most one issued feedback event per conversation revision. If an issued event has not been acknowledged by the parent checkpoint cursor, the same event is redelivered; it is not a new retry allowance.
recovery_eligibility.meaning: Optional factual continuation opportunity, not a retry action, an answer-quality judgment or an instruction to publish.

card_operation_routes.inputs: Text plus optional citations and card ID; withdrawal names an observed card. The runtime supplies the observation cursor and observed card snapshot.

ordered_routes.condition: Same stable tool call ID already recorded with matching name/arguments
ordered_routes.outcome: Return cached result without applying the local action again

ordered_routes.condition: Unseen conversation or source arrival newer than cursor
Current card differs from the snapshot the agent saw
ordered_routes.outcome: conflict plus current_card; no automatic replacement or retry

ordered_routes.condition: Publishing identical text and citation list to the unchanged observed active card while window is open
Remaining publication/withdrawal request passes replay action checks
Replay action rejected, such as closed observation window or inactive withdrawal target
ordered_routes.outcome: Error tool result; no requested action applied

card_operation_routes.citation_handling: Unknown requested source IDs are omitted and reported. Valid or present source IDs do not establish factual correctness.
card_operation_routes.next_control: The result returns in the tool batch; the agent decides whether to reconsider or change action. No approval gate or automatic retry is added.
card_operation_routes.storage: Local card effects and their tool receipt share the WorldStore transaction; graph checkpoints are a separate database.

model_request_durability.before_dispatch: Accounting persists a pending reservation, request role and known-budget limits. Duplicate reserved call IDs are rejected, not resent.
model_request_durability.after_completion: Known usage, measured wall duration and outcome are persisted. Completed calls advance simulated time and may make queued events arrive.
model_request_durability.after_failure: A failure outcome is recorded when the callback can finish it. Unknown/pending calls remain counted. Non-scripted resume refuses runs with failed or unfinished calls.
model_request_durability.limits: Known usage is checked before each request. A final request can exceed the soft token budget; unknown usage may add cost. The ledger does not guarantee exactly-once network effects or zero re-computation after every crash.

critical_distinctions: A completed tool receipt is distinct from a completed delayed evidence job.
A wait-only batch and a mixed wait-plus-ordinary-tool batch can take different native routes.
An investigator turn ending is distinct from the whole replay run ending.
A transient progress projection is distinct from durable history or another model decision.
A card-state rejection is feedback for the agent, not an automatic retry or semantic release approval.
Graph checkpoints and WorldStore actions use separate databases; local transaction guarantees do not extend to model-provider requests.
A saved graph, a finished run or a valid card commit is not evidence of a correct or useful answer.
limitations: This describes the current source and installed native routing code inspected on the review date, not a new behavioral test.
The prototype uses synthetic replay, fictional documents and diagnostic retrieval. No live microphone, real ASR, live web retrieval or human benefit is established.
Automatic context preparation exists, but a component appearing in the architecture does not mean it fired in the held-out study.
The detailed component graph is a documented interpretation of the source. The actual compiled outer graph still has only observe and investigate between start and end.
No private model request, response, reasoning, credentials or personal conversation content is included in this evidence record.

review_method.existing_artifact_read: Saved compiled graph only; no new run or replay was executed.

provenance.path_convention: Repository-relative file paths. Files under .venv are installed dependency source read locally for exact routing; paths are not public download URLs.
provenance.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of source-file bytes at review time.
